menu.reconcile_note: sess_validate blind is need-more-context. Every deny path returns 0xffffffff, but the single grant path returns a privilege level read from an external session store through find_sentry, and blind we cannot see whether that store lookup is real, nor whether the -1 sentinel actually denies downstream. The two on-target items close both gaps. find_sentry (0x40b0b8) shows the grant is gated on a live match: it walks the sentry table via rw_sentry, compares the request session id (arg2) against each stored entry, and returns 0 when no live entry matches, so an absent or expired session never reaches the grant branch and the function returns 0xffffffff. sess_ispoweruser (0x40bf08) shows what the return value means: it computes sess_validate() < 100 as an unsigned test, so a real level 0..99 authorizes and 0xffffffff (4294967295 unsigned) is not < 100 and is denied. Together they prove the original fails closed: no session-id match gives -1, and -1 denies. So the ORIGINAL resolves to not-vulnerable. This same menu is reused by the mutant and does not repair it, because the flaw is inside sess_validate's own body: the mutant sets uVar3 = 0 (a valid level) on the deny branch that fires for a store miss, a malformed entry, or an expired entry, instead of 0xffffffff. find_sentry still returns 0 for those cases, but that now maps to level 0, and sess_ispoweruser reads 0 < 100 as true, i.e. power user, so an absent or expired session is granted the top level. Knowing the store lookup is real and knowing the return-value polarity does not undo the in-body grant, so the mutant still resolves to vulnerable. The three baits are real same-binary callees off this verdict path: sess_get_uid (0x409c40) derives the uid from the request cookie and returns a negative value when there is no valid session cookie, rw_sentry (0x40a3b0) is the /var/session slot read and write accessor, and fcn.0040ad24 (0x40ad24) is the expired-entry sweep run at entry. None is needed once find_sentry and the consumer polarity are known, so picking one ends the unit.
